newsitem.title: USA: Summit Bancorp starts Internet site.
newsitem.headline: Summit Bancorp starts Internet site.

text.p: Summit Bancorp, New Jersey's largest bank, said it has launched an Internet site that includes educational content and interactive tools.
A spokeswoman said the site, accessible at www.summitbank.com., is not currently transactional.
"The primary function right now is as an information medium," she said. "It also enables customers to do financial calculations.
The Internet site is separate from a personal computer banking service Summit launched last month. The spokeswoman said the PC service has had a "tremendous response."
Summit said the site was developed by Quadravision Communications Ltd.
